tagline.en: From Denny's dishwasher to king of AI compute
tagline.zh: 从 Denny's 洗碗工到 AI 算力之王

label.zh: NVIDIA 上市前股权 + 个人储蓄

t.en: Uprooted youth
t.zh: 少年漂泊

desc.en: Born in Tainan, sent to a US boarding school at 9, working at Denny's at 15
desc.zh: 台南出生，9 岁赴美进寄宿学校，15 岁在 Denny's 打工

t.en: Chip engineer
t.zh: 芯片工程师

desc.en: Designs chips at AMD and LSI Logic while earning a Stanford master's part-time
desc.zh: AMD、LSI Logic 做芯片设计，边工作边读斯坦福硕士

t.en: Near-death startup
t.zh: 创业九死一生

desc.en: Founds NVIDIA in a Denny's booth; recovers from the NV1 failure with the RIVA 128
desc.zh: 在 Denny's 卡座创立 NVIDIA；NV1 失利后靠 RIVA 128 翻盘

t.en: The GPU era
t.zh: GPU 时代与上市沉浮

desc.en: GeForce defines the GPU, CUDA lays the groundwork, and the stock loses 80% in 2008
desc.zh: GeForce 定义 GPU，CUDA 埋下伏笔，2008 年股价跌去八成

t.en: Betting on deep learning
t.zh: 押注深度学习

desc.en: AlexNet wins on GeForce cards and NVIDIA turns fully toward AI
desc.zh: AlexNet 用 GeForce 夺冠，NVIDIA 全面转向 AI

t.en: King of AI compute
t.zh: AI 算力之王

desc.en: ChatGPT sets off demand; market cap goes from $1T to $5T
desc.zh: ChatGPT 引爆需求，市值从 1 万亿走到 5 万亿

t.en: Born in Tainan, Taiwan
t.zh: 出生于台湾台南

summary.en: Jensen Huang was born in Tainan and spent part of his early childhood in Thailand with his family.
summary.zh: 黄仁勋生于台南，幼年随家人在泰国生活。

why.en: Starting point, not scored. Human capital starts at the average for his US age group.
why.zh: 起点事件，不计分；人力资本以美国同龄人平均水平为初始值。

t.en: Sent to the US at 9 and ends up at a boarding school for troubled youth
t.zh: 9岁被送往美国，误入"问题少年"寄宿学校

summary.en: He and his older brother were sent to Oneida Baptist Institute in Kentucky. Relatives thought it was a prestigious school; it was in fact a boarding school for troubled teenagers. He has recalled cleaning the dormitory toilets every day.
summary.zh: 他和哥哥被送到肯塔基州的 Oneida Baptist Institute。亲戚以为是名校，实际是一所管教问题青少年的寄宿学校；他曾回忆自己每天要打扫宿舍厕所。

why.en: A period of hardship: human capital is held down rather than rising. He later retold the story many times, and it became part of the backstory behind his reputation capital.
why.zh: 逆境期：人力资本不升反压，但后来被他反复讲述，成为日后声誉资本的"故事底仓"。

t.en: Works at Denny's at 15: washing dishes, busing tables, waiting on customers
t.zh: 15岁在 Denny's 打工：洗碗、收桌、当服务员

summary.en: He worked at the Denny's restaurant chain during high school. Years later, NVIDIA was conceived in a booth at a Denny's.
summary.zh: 高中时在连锁餐厅 Denny's 打工。多年后 NVIDIA 恰好在一家 Denny's 的卡座里被构思出来。

why.en: Negligible financial value. The media cited it widely after 2023 as a humble-beginnings story, which adds slowly to reputation capital over the long term.
why.zh: 金融价值可忽略；作为"草根叙事"在 2023 年后被媒体大量引用，给声誉资本留下长期复利。

t.en: Graduates from Oregon State University in electrical engineering
t.zh: 俄勒冈州立大学电子工程学士毕业

summary.en: He earned a bachelor's degree in electrical engineering. His lab partner, Lori, later became his wife.
summary.zh: 获得电子工程学士学位；在实验室搭档中结识了后来的妻子 Lori。

why.en: Education step: the human capital target rises from about $500K to about $1.5M, phased in smoothly with a time constant of about one year.
why.zh: 学历台阶：人力资本目标值从约 50 万上调至约 150 万美元，按约一年时间常数平滑爬升。

t.en: Designs chips at AMD, then LSI Logic
t.zh: 加入 AMD、LSI Logic 做芯片设计

summary.en: After graduating he designed microprocessors at AMD, then spent nearly eight years at LSI Logic, where he moved into management.
summary.zh: 毕业后先在 AMD 做微处理器设计，随后在 LSI Logic 工作近八年，转向管理岗位。

why.en: First high-skill job; human capital is raised slightly.
why.zh: 首份高技能工作，人力资本小幅上调。

t.en: Earns a Stanford master's in electrical engineering while working
t.zh: 斯坦福电子工程硕士（边工作边读）

summary.en: He completed a master's degree in electrical engineering at Stanford University while working full-time.
summary.zh: 在职期间取得斯坦福大学电子工程硕士学位。

why.en: A degree from a top university; human capital is raised.
why.zh: 名校学历加成，人力资本上调。

t.en: Founds NVIDIA with two co-founders in a Denny's booth
t.zh: 与两位联合创始人在 Denny's 卡座里创立 NVIDIA

summary.en: He co-founded NVIDIA with Chris Malachowsky and Curtis Priem with about $40,000 in starting capital. Sequoia Capital and other firms invested later that year.
summary.zh: 与 Chris Malachowsky、Curtis Priem 共同创立 NVIDIA，起步资金约 4 万美元，同年获得红杉资本等机构的早期投资。

why.en: A turning point: he now holds equity in a company. Financial capital switches from personal savings to the value of his founder's stake.
why.zh: 人生转折点：开始持有一家公司的股权。金融资本从个人储蓄切换为"创始人股权估值"。

fin.en: Equity value enters the model (interpolated from funding-round valuations while private)
fin.zh: 股权估值进入模型（私有期按融资估值插值）

t.en: NV1 fails, leaving the company "30 days" from going under
t.zh: NV1 失利，公司离倒闭只剩"30天"

summary.en: NVIDIA's first chip, the NV1, was built around quadrilateral rendering, which was incompatible with the industry standard, and it sold poorly. Work on a next-generation chip for Sega had to be stopped. The company laid off much of its staff. Huang told Sega the truth, and Sega still invested about $5M, which kept the company alive. "We are 30 days from going out of business" later became one of his standard lines.
summary.zh: 首款芯片 NV1 押注四边形渲染，与业界主流不兼容，卖不动；为世嘉开发的下一代芯片被迫叫停。公司大幅裁员，黄仁勋向世嘉坦白，对方仍投资约 500 万美元帮公司续命。"我们离破产只有 30 天"后来成了他的口头禅。

why.en: Equity value is cut sharply (about -70%). This is the closest NVIDIA has come to failing.
why.zh: 股权估值大幅下修（约 -70%），这是 NVIDIA 历史上最接近死亡的时刻。

fin.zh: 私有估值：约 200 万 → 约 60 万美元

t.en: RIVA 128 launches and rescues the company
t.zh: RIVA 128 发布，绝境翻盘

summary.en: The RIVA 128, built for the mainstream Direct3D standard, sold well and brought the company back from the brink.
summary.zh: 转向主流 Direct3D 架构的 RIVA 128 大卖，公司起死回生。

why.en: The product proves itself → the next funding round is priced higher and equity value recovers.
why.zh: 产品验证 → 下一轮融资估值抬升，股权价值回升。

fin.zh: 私有估值：约 60 万 → 约 300 万美元

t.en: Lists on Nasdaq at $12 a share
t.zh: 纳斯达克上市，发行价 12 美元

summary.en: NVIDIA went public on Nasdaq and rose sharply on its first day. From this day on, Huang's financial capital has a real daily market price.
summary.zh: NVIDIA 在纳斯达克 IPO，首日大涨。从这一天起，黄仁勋的金融资本有了每日真实报价。

why.en: Anchor switch: financial capital = ownership share × shares outstanding × that day's share price (split-adjusted).
why.zh: 锚点切换：金融资本 = 持股比例 × 总股本 × 当日股价（拆股复权）。

fin.en: Valued daily from NVDA closing prices from here on
fin.zh: 开始按 NVDA 日线逐日计价

t.en: GeForce 256 launches and NVIDIA introduces the term "GPU"
t.zh: GeForce 256 发布，NVIDIA 提出 "GPU" 概念

summary.en: NVIDIA called the GeForce 256 "the world's first GPU". The name went on to define the whole product category.
summary.zh: NVIDIA 将 GeForce 256 称为"世界上第一款 GPU"，这个名字后来定义了整个品类。

why.en: Naming a category is a long-term reputation asset. Reputation factor +3%, released gradually along a decay curve.
why.zh: 品类定义权 = 长期声誉资产；口碑系数 +3%，按衰减曲线慢慢释放。

t.en: Wins the graphics chip contract for Microsoft's first Xbox
t.zh: 拿下微软初代 Xbox 图形芯片订单

summary.en: Microsoft chose NVIDIA to supply the graphics processor for the original Xbox.
summary.zh: 微软选择 NVIDIA 为初代 Xbox 提供图形处理器。

why.en: An endorsement from a major customer. It shows up mainly in the share price, so the model does not count it again.
why.zh: 大客户背书，主要通过股价体现，模型不重复加分。

t.en: Dot-com bust and a troubled product launch drag the stock down all year
t.zh: 泡沫破裂 + 新品不顺，股价全年重挫

summary.en: The dot-com crash pulled down technology stocks. At the same time, the new GeForce FX was delayed and poorly received.
summary.zh: 互联网泡沫破裂拖累科技股，同时新一代 GeForce FX 研发延误、口碑不佳。

why.en: Financial capital is reflected automatically in the share price. The weaker product reputation takes a further 2% off the reputation factor.
why.zh: 金融资本由股价自动反映；产品口碑下滑另扣口碑系数 -2%。

t.en: CUDA launches, opening GPUs to general-purpose computing
t.zh: CUDA 问世：让 GPU 能做通用计算

summary.en: Wall Street saw it at the time as a side project that weighed on margins, and it paid nothing back for years. More than a decade later it became NVIDIA's strongest competitive advantage in AI.
summary.zh: 当时华尔街把它看成拖累毛利的"副业"，多年没有回报；十多年后它成了 AI 时代 NVIDIA 最深的护城河。

why.en: A typical compounding event: short-term financial contribution ≈ 0, while human and reputation capital grow slowly over the long term.
why.zh: 典型的复利型事件：短期金融贡献 ≈ 0，人力资本与声誉资本长期缓慢增值。

t.en: Laptop chip defect and lowered forecast send the stock down about 30% in a day
t.zh: 笔记本芯片缺陷 + 下调预期，单日暴跌约三成

summary.en: The company disclosed that some laptop GPUs were defective and that it would take a charge, and it cut its revenue forecast. The stock fell sharply in one day.
summary.zh: 公司披露部分笔记本 GPU 存在缺陷需计提损失，并下调营收预期，股价单日重挫。

why.en: Financial capital is reflected in NVDA daily prices. The quality problem takes a further 3% off the reputation factor.
why.zh: 金融资本由 NVDA 日线反映；质量问题叠加扣口碑系数 -3%。

t.en: Financial crisis: stock falls about 80% from its peak
t.zh: 金融危机：股价较高点跌去约八成

summary.en: The global financial crisis came on top of product problems, and NVDA fell steadily from its 2007 high.
summary.zh: 全球金融危机叠加产品问题，NVDA 从 2007 年高点一路下跌。

why.en: A market-wide decline, driven entirely by the share price. No extra reputation penalty.
why.zh: 系统性下跌，纯股价驱动，不额外扣声誉。

t.en: AlexNet wins ImageNet using two GeForce cards
t.zh: AlexNet 用两块 GeForce 显卡夺得 ImageNet 冠军

summary.en: AlexNet, trained by a University of Toronto team on two GTX 580 cards, won by a wide margin. This marked the start of the deep learning era, and GPUs became the standard hardware for AI training.
summary.zh: 多伦多大学团队用两块 GTX 580 训练的 AlexNet 大幅领先，深度学习时代由此开启，GPU 成为 AI 训练的标准硬件。

why.en: The CUDA investment starts to pay off. The share price did not react at the time, but the reputation factor among AI researchers rises 4% (released slowly).
why.zh: CUDA 的复利开始兑现：当时股价无反应，但 AI 圈口碑系数 +4%（缓慢释放）。

t.en: Hand-delivers the first DGX-1 supercomputer to OpenAI
t.zh: 亲手把第一台 DGX-1 超算送给 OpenAI

summary.en: Huang personally delivered the first DGX-1 AI supercomputer to OpenAI. The photo was widely recirculated after ChatGPT took off.
summary.zh: 黄仁勋把首台 DGX-1 AI 超级计算机亲自送到 OpenAI。这个画面在 ChatGPT 爆火后被反复引用。

why.en: A reputation event whose significance only became clear later. Reputation factor +2%.
why.zh: 典型"埋伏笔"的声誉事件，口碑系数 +2%。

t.en: Crypto demand fades and inventory piles up; stock falls nearly 20% after earnings
t.zh: 加密货币退潮、库存积压，财报后单日大跌近两成

summary.en: A sudden drop in crypto-mining demand left a glut of gaming graphics cards, and guidance came in far below expectations.
summary.zh: 挖矿需求骤降导致游戏显卡库存积压，业绩指引大幅低于预期。

why.en: Financial capital is reflected in the share price. Doubts about the company's reliance on crypto take 2% off the reputation factor.
why.zh: 金融资本由股价反映；对"加密货币依赖"的质疑扣口碑系数 -2%。

t.en: Completes the roughly $6.9B acquisition of Mellanox
t.zh: 完成约 69 亿美元收购 Mellanox

summary.en: NVIDIA acquired Mellanox, an Israeli networking chip company, adding data center networking to its lineup.
summary.zh: 收购以色列网络芯片公司 Mellanox，补齐数据中心互联能力。

why.en: A strategic move, reflected mainly in the share price.
why.zh: 战略布局，主要由股价反映。

t.en: Announces $40B deal to acquire Arm
t.zh: 宣布 400 亿美元收购 Arm

summary.en: NVIDIA announced it would acquire Arm, the chip architecture company, in what was described as one of the largest deals in semiconductor history.
summary.zh: 宣布收购芯片架构公司 Arm，号称半导体史上最大交易之一。

why.en: A signal of ambition. Reputation factor +1%.
why.zh: 野心信号，口碑系数 +1%。

t.en: Arm acquisition abandoned under regulatory pressure
t.zh: 收购 Arm 因监管阻力告吹

summary.en: The deal was called off after opposition from regulators in the US, the UK, the EU and elsewhere.
summary.zh: 面对美、英、欧盟等监管机构的反对，交易终止。

why.en: A strategic setback. Reputation factor -1%.
why.zh: 战略受挫，口碑系数 -1%。

t.en: US imposes export controls on advanced chips to China
t.zh: 美国出台对华高端芯片出口管制

summary.en: The US Commerce Department restricted exports of advanced AI chips to China, affecting some NVIDIA products.
summary.zh: 美国商务部限制向中国出口高端 AI 芯片，NVIDIA 的部分产品受影响。

why.en: An external policy shock, reflected in the share price. No personal reputation penalty.
why.zh: 外部政策冲击，由股价反映，不扣个人声誉。

t.en: ChatGPT launches and the AI arms race begins
t.zh: ChatGPT 发布，AI 军备竞赛开始

summary.en: Training and running large AI models depend almost entirely on NVIDIA GPUs, and the demand curve changed for good from this point.
summary.zh: 大模型的训练和推理几乎都依赖 NVIDIA GPU，需求曲线从此彻底改变。

why.en: An external trigger that starts the steepest climb of his career. Reputation factor +5%, and the baseline level of media attention begins to rise.
why.zh: 外部引爆点，开启"人生主升浪"；口碑系数 +5%，媒体热度基线开始抬升。

t.en: Revenue guidance far exceeds expectations; stock jumps about 24% the next day
t.zh: 营收指引大超预期，次日股价大涨约 24%

summary.en: The company issued quarterly revenue guidance far above Wall Street estimates. It was the first time the market grasped the scale of AI demand.
summary.zh: 公司给出远超华尔街预期的季度营收指引，市场第一次意识到 AI 需求的规模。

why.en: The one-day jump in financial capital is reflected in the share price. NVIDIA becomes established as the "picks and shovels" supplier of AI. Reputation factor +3%.
why.zh: 金融资本单日跳升由股价反映；"AI 卖铲人"叙事确立，口碑系数 +3%。

t.en: Market cap passes $1T for the first time
t.zh: 市值首次突破 1 万亿美元

summary.en: NVIDIA became the first chip company with a market value above $1 trillion.
summary.zh: NVIDIA 成为首家市值突破万亿美元的芯片公司。

why.en: The milestone brings a peak in media attention.
why.zh: 里程碑效应带来媒体热度峰值。

t.en: Unveils Blackwell at GTC 2024, dubbed the "Woodstock of AI"
t.zh: GTC 2024 发布 Blackwell，被称为"AI 界的伍德斯托克"

summary.en: The developer conference was held in a hockey arena and felt like a rock concert. NVIDIA unveiled its next-generation Blackwell architecture there.
summary.zh: 在一座冰球馆里开发者大会开得像摇滚演唱会，发布新一代 Blackwell 架构。

why.en: A high point for his personal profile, with peaks in both media coverage and search interest. Reputation factor +3%.
why.zh: 个人 IP 高光时刻，媒体与搜索热度双峰；口碑系数 +3%。

t.en: "Jensanity" at Computex in Taipei
t.zh: 台北 Computex "黄仁勋旋风"

summary.en: In Taiwan he gave a keynote, visited night markets and signed autographs for fans. Crowds gathered wherever he went, and he drew celebrity-level attention across the Chinese-speaking world.
summary.zh: 在台湾演讲、逛夜市、给粉丝签名，所到之处被围观，在华语圈掀起明星级热潮。

why.en: Audience size jumps as he reaches a mainstream Chinese-speaking audience. Reputation factor +3%. Follower growth is phased in along a smooth curve rather than as a one-day jump.
why.zh: 受众规模跃升（华语圈破圈），口碑系数 +3%；粉丝增长按平滑曲线计入，不做一天跳涨。

t.en: Briefly passes Microsoft to become the world's most valuable company
t.zh: 市值一度超过微软，登顶全球第一

summary.en: NVIDIA briefly became the most valuable company in the world.
summary.zh: NVIDIA 短暂成为全球市值最高的公司。

why.en: A milestone peak in attention. The financial side is reflected in the share price.
why.zh: 里程碑热度峰值，金融部分由股价反映。

t.en: DeepSeek shock: about $589B in market value lost in one day
t.zh: DeepSeek 冲击：单日蒸发约 5,890 亿美元

summary.en: The Chinese company DeepSeek released a low-cost, high-performing model. Investors worried that demand for computing power had been overestimated, and NVDA fell about 17% in one day, the largest single-day loss of market value in US stock market history.
summary.zh: 中国公司 DeepSeek 发布低成本高性能模型，市场担心算力需求被高估，NVDA 单日暴跌约 17%，创美股单日市值损失纪录。

why.en: The one-day drop in financial capital is reflected in the share price. The challenge to the compute-demand thesis takes 2% off the reputation factor. The concern later proved unfounded, and the factor recovers as the penalty decays.
why.zh: 金融资本单日大跌由股价反映；"算力叙事被挑战"扣口碑系数 -2%，但后续被证伪，系数随衰减修复。

t.en: H20 exports to China require a license; about $5.5B charge expected
t.zh: H20 对华出口需许可，预计计提约 55 亿美元

summary.en: The US government began requiring a license to export H20 chips to China. The company expected related losses of about $5.5B.
summary.zh: 美国政府要求 H20 芯片对华出口需申请许可，公司预计相关损失约 55 亿美元。

why.en: A policy shock, reflected in the share price.
why.zh: 政策冲击，由股价反映。

t.en: Becomes the world's first $4T company
t.zh: 全球首家市值 4 万亿美元公司

summary.en: NVIDIA's market value passed $4 trillion for the first time during trading.
summary.zh: NVIDIA 市值盘中首次突破 4 万亿美元。

why.en: A milestone peak in attention.
why.zh: 里程碑热度峰值。

t.en: Becomes the world's first $5T company
t.zh: 全球首家市值 5 万亿美元公司

summary.en: Less than four months after reaching $4 trillion, its market value passed $5 trillion.
summary.zh: 距 4 万亿不到四个月，市值再破 5 万亿美元。

why.en: A milestone peak in attention.
why.zh: 里程碑热度峰值。
